paragraphs: FASTER sells fleet management and asset maintenance software as one platform. The public sector is the core audience, built for municipalities, school systems, transit, and utilities.

Coverage runs from acquisition planning through disposal of an asset. Day to day, that means automated preventive maintenance scheduling, real-time parts tracking, and streamlined work orders. Managers track total cost of ownership, downtime, and utilization by vehicle, department, or fleet. A customer portal lets vehicle users request repairs online, view repair history, and manage appointments.

The company says more than 400 organizations manage over one million assets on FASTER across North America. Those customers include city governments, universities, utilities, public works departments, and private fleet operators. The site claims over 40 years of helping organizations run safer, smarter, and more efficiently. It describes itself as a US-based company with US-based product, engineering, and support teams. The homepage also lists SOC 2 compliant security and data protection. FASTER is part of Transit Technologies.
